description:
Expands Twitter/X links into readable, shareable Markdown format.
Social Thread Markdown allows you to convert Twitter (X) threads and tweets into a clean, readable Markdown format. 
Simply share a Twitter link to the app, or paste it manually, and Social Thread Markdown will fetch the content, including images and quoted tweets, and format it into Markdown. 
You can preview, edit, and then share the Markdown directly to your favorite note-taking or publishing apps.

Features:
- Expand single tweets or full threads (by sharing the last tweet).
- Extract images from tweets.
- Customizable formatting: choose whether to include original links, dates, and author usernames.
- Save full offline history of expanded tweets.
- Fast and clean formatting powered by api.fxtwitter.com.
